label: LLM plugins
summary: LLM plugins are add-ons generated by or used alongside tools like Claude Code to extend what a single AI tool can do. The idea is that by stacking multiple plugins, each covering a distinct role, you can simulate a broader team setup within one workflow. The triples show this as a demonstration of role-based collaboration.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike references LLM plugins in the context of Claude Code, specifically framing them as a way to cover different team functions like planning, design, code review, security, memory, and coordination. The angle is practical and speed-focused: five minutes to something that resembles a full dev team. There is not enough material across multiple posts to say more than that.
open_questions: How well does role-based collaboration via plugins actually hold up compared to a real team, and does Maaike think the framing is overstated?
Are these plugins reusable across projects or tightly coupled to specific Claude Code sessions?
